$comment: THE single source of truth for environment identity across Enterprise Operations OS.
Originally the C3/D2 drift registry (which environments exist, where their frontends are);
extended by O-3 to also carry each environment's Firebase identity and capability readiness,
so there is ONE authoritative mechanism rather than separate ad hoc ones for D2, R-2, Firebase
configuration, readiness flags, and operator scripts.
READ-ONLY DECLARATION. Nothing here provisions, deploys, renames, or mutates infrastructure.
Adding an entry does not create an environment; it records one that exists or is planned.
MODELLING: `role` (what an environment is FOR) is independent of `deployment` (whose instance
it is). `production` is NOT synonymous with Taylor Parts — see docs/architecture/ADR-011.
PRIVATE AI DATA CLASSIFICATION: `privateAiSyntheticOperationalInterpretation` declares whether an
environment's operational evidence is synthetic, and so whether a trusted Function may send it to the
private model for interpretation. It is a SERVER-SIDE data classification, not a client transport gate,
so it is deliberately NOT part of `readiness` and is never projected into the browser bundle. Absent or
false means refuse, and scripts/resolveEnvironment.mjs requires the boolean explicitly, so an
environment that forgets it is a build error rather than a silent default.
It is false for every environment declared here. platform-sandbox is false because the fixture pipeline
that populates it is production-derived; its purpose line used to call that data synthetic, which was a
description contradicting the classification beside it, and has been corrected. Production is false in
the data AND hard-blocked by role in the resolver, so neither one alone has to be trusted.
SECRETS: `firebase` holds PUBLIC Firebase Web client configuration only. A Firebase Web apiKey
is a public project identifier, not a credential — access is enforced by Firestore Rules and
Auth, not by hiding it. No service-account key, token, or private credential belongs in this
file, and a test asserts that.

environments.purpose: Local developer/agent execution against the Firebase Emulator Suite. Synthetic data only; never production credentials.
environments.notes: Firebase identity is null by design: the emulator path is opt-in via ?emulator=1 and DEV-gated, and must never carry a real project identity.

environments.purpose: Persistent non-production platform environment: governed test personas, full integrated application. Its dataset is NOT governed as synthetic -- the fixture pipeline that populates it is production-derived -- which is why privateAiSyntheticOperationalInterpretation is false here.
environments.$capabilityActivationOverrides_comment: Per-environment activation of the sales/fulfillment/finance spine (all catalog active:false) -- lifts the blanket active:false DENY in THIS sandbox only so the Opportunity->SO->Fulfillment->Billing flow is testable. Activation != authorization: a persona still needs a qualifying Role grant. NO role:production environment may carry this key (environmentCapabilityOverrides.ts is additionally role-keyed, and environmentArchitecture.test.mjs asserts absence). See docs/design/per-environment-capability-activation-spec.md.

surfaces.notes: Stable Owner review URL. Rebuilt freely; no delete protection, PITR or backups by design.

environments.notes: Provisioned 2026-08-06 (O-1..O-8). Complete platform estate: 35 Functions (13 more than production, which has never deployed the Enterprise Access + Supplier Master callables), full Rules, all 6 indexes.

environments.purpose: Deployable synthetic certification runtime. It exists so the private-AI operational interpretation path can be exercised end to end against data that is genuinely synthetic, which platform-sandbox's production-derived fixtures are not. Its dataset is seeded only from the certification-world fixture authority; no production or production-derived record may be copied here.
environments.$capabilityActivationOverrides_comment: Owner ruling CERT-CYCLE-11 (2026-09-02). The G07 cycle-count ceremony and NOTHING else. inventory.cycleCount.cancel is deliberately EXCLUDED -- the ceremony never cancels a count, and certification authority is widened only as far as the scenario requires. inventory.transfer.* and inventory.returns.intake remain separate future decisions. permissionCatalog keeps these ids active:false; this per-environment override is the governed activation seam, and a Role grant is still required on top of it.
environments.notes: Provisioned 2026-08-30: Firestore (Standard, production mode, deny-by-default rules) and a Web app registration for the governed identity above. NO Functions, Hosting or browser surface is deployed here and this environment serves no browser -- which is why every readiness flag stays false. It DOES hold a governed synthetic Firestore world (certification-world fixture authority), exercised by bounded repository-owned Certification operator tools rather than by a client. Capabilities remain inactive unless explicitly Owner-authorized per environment; see capabilityActivationOverrides.

environments.purpose: Exact integrated Release Candidate on a stable Owner-review URL with a known SHA.
environments.notes: NOT PROVISIONED. Initially expected to share infrastructure with platform-sandbox as a distinct logical role; the forcing condition for a physical split is concurrency (an RC under review while sandbox rebuilds).

environments.purpose: First customer production deployment of Enterprise Operations OS.

surfaces.notes: Owner-authorized, evidenced releases. SPA catch-all rewrite returns 200 + text/html for any unmatched path, so manifest ABSENCE cannot be detected by status code — the checker validates content, never status alone.
Auto-publishes on merge to main, outside the promotion lifecycle. Recorded as an open governance gap (R-2); this registry observes it and does not change it.
